Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. Q2 Earnings Strong
: Goldman Sachs (GS) Q2: revenue $20.34B, net income $6.63B (32.6% of revenue), annualized ROE 23.5% — strong earnings tied to active markets.
Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. backs EPC Power Sale
: Goldman Sachs (GS) invested via Goldman Sachs Alternatives in EPC Power and advised on its $4.4B sale to Flex, backing EPC’s push into AI data-center power, grid upgrades and domestic manufacturing
Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. Raises IG Supply Forecast
: Goldman Sachs raised its 2026 USD investment-grade gross supply forecast to $2.3T (from $2.1T) and 2027 to $2.4T, noting about 24% of 2026 supply is from AI-related issuers.
Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. XRP ETF Holdings
: Goldman Sachs (GS) held $87.4M in U.S.-listed spot XRP ETFs at quarter-end, up $83.1M from the prior quarter, per its Q2 13F filings compiled by Bloomberg Intelligence
